from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentDetails(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document that serve as match keys against the outcome options."""
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of the case, e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative, State Compensation")
    procedure: str | None = Field(description="The procedural context, e.g., Second Instance Appeal, Retrial, Complaint, Withdrawal")
    appellant_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the appellant or complainant named in the document")
    respondent_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the respondent named in the document")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Specific case number referenced in the text")
    first_instance_fee: str | None = Field(description="Amount of the first instance case acceptance fee if stated")
    second_instance_fee: str | None = Field(description="Amount of the second instance case acceptance fee if stated")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling result text, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原判', '驳回申诉'")
    is_final: bool = Field(description="Whether the document explicitly states it is a final judgment or ruling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for the extracted features of the processed document."""
    documents: list[DocumentDetails]
